answer: An archive of falcon imagery, violet spectra and glacier models can reward storage instead of identities. Each rented replica must use a provider-specific encoding. After commitment, random audits demand proofs of the encoded blocks before a deadline too short to rebuild them. Divide a fixed pool by audited replica bytes, with no signup bonus. A thousand keys sharing one copy cannot prove a thousand distinct replicas; farming more shares costs disk space, encoding work and bandwidth. This assumes sound proofs and no cheap encoding shortcut.
